request.terms.1: 1. Rental Agreement: By submitting this request, you acknowledge that the rental is subject to availability and approval. A formal rental agreement will be provided upon approval.
request.terms.2: 2. Payment: Full payment including deposit is due before equipment delivery. Deposits are refundable upon return of equipment in good condition.
request.terms.3: 3. Equipment Care: You are responsible for the proper use and care of rented equipment. Any damage beyond normal wear will be assessed and charged accordingly.
request.terms.4: 4. Insurance: Selected insurance coverage applies as described. You are responsible for any costs exceeding the insurance coverage.
request.terms.5: 5. Cancellation: Cancellation requests must be made at least 48 hours before the rental start date for a full deposit refund.
request.terms.6: 6. Late Returns: Equipment returned after the agreed-upon end date will incur daily rate charges for each additional day.

rolling.title: Open-ended rolling rental
rolling.hint: 28-day arrears settlement; pickup and return inspection remain required before completion.
rolling.startHint: Use this when renewal is confirmed but the return date is unknown. Existing pricing stays unchanged and each completed 28-day period is invoiced in arrears.
rolling.historicalWarning: This rental is already past its planned end date. Review the catch-up amount before classifying it as a rolling renewal; no historical data is changed until confirmation.
rolling.historicalCutoffInvalid: Choose a time after the original rental end and no later than now.
rolling.companyDefault: Company responsibility is recorded by default, so billing stops at the customer-ready time. An audited correction can assign the delay to the customer.
rolling.companyBillingRule: Company delay: billing remains stopped at the customer-ready time.
rolling.customerBillingRule: Customer delay: billing continues until every unit is physically picked up.
management.chargeDeleteNoPermission: You do not have permission to delete charges (super admin only)
management.waiveChargeHint: The issued invoice is left unchanged; a credit note (incl. tax) is raised to offset this charge.
